title: PluralCraft
description: Allows systems to better represent themselved in Minecraft!
body:
# What is PluralCraft?
PluralCraft is a plugin for PaperMC (and forks) which allows easier role playing with a member system, allowing you to quickly switch between members.

# What can PluralCraft do?
Members allow you to set:
- Your display name
- Your skin
- More soon!

# How do you use PluralCraft?
- First you need to setup a group using the command `/pluralcraft create <groupName>`
- Once that is complete, you can add members to your group by using `/pluralcraft add <id> <memberName>`, the ID will be used in further commands
- You can then set the actively chatting member using the command `/pluralcraft setActiveMember <id>`
- You can remove members from your group via `/pluralcraft remove <id>`
- You can clear the current active member by using `/pluralcraft clearActiveMember`, this will reset your chat to your Minecraft account
- You can delete your group of members by running `/pluralcraft delete`
- You can run `/pluralcraft getActiveMember` to get the current active member (or add a player name after that to get another player's active member!)
- You can view your current system using `/pluralcraft getSystemInfo` (or add a player name after that to get another player's group information!)
- You can set the skin of a member with the command `/pluralcraft setMemberSkin <id> <skinUrl>`

# Why was PluralCraft made?
PluralCraft was made in order to support people with DID (Dissociative Identity Disorder), allowing them to better represent themselves in Minecraft! However, it also made the perfect role playing plugin! I decided it would be better to advertise that over DID which is much more niché.

And most importantly... this plugin allows you to system represent system system represent be system. (I'm sorry Kasai XD)
